item.title: ​The EBA appoints Kristīne Černaja-Mežmale as its new Vice-Chair
item.description: ​The Board of Supervisors of the European Banking Authority (EBA) has elected Kristīne Černaja-Mežmale as its Vice-Chair for a duration of two and a half years. Ms Černaja-Mežmale will take up her new role on 1 November 2026 when the current EBA Vice-Chair, Helmut Ettl starts his new role as Executive Director of the International Monetary Fund (IMF). — Thématique finance ; source jugée fiable (european banking authority) ; impact marché.
